name: Get metadata taxonomies for namespace
description: Get metadata taxonomies for namespace Used to retrieve all metadata taxonomies in a namespace. GET /2.0/metadata_taxonomies/{namespace}
context:
GET /2.0/metadata_taxonomies/{namespace}
Used to retrieve all metadata taxonomies in a namespace.
Required: namespace (path) — The namespace of the metadata taxonomy.
Optional: marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.

name: Get metadata taxonomy by taxonomy key
description: Get metadata taxonomy by taxonomy key Used to retrieve a metadata taxonomy by taxonomy key. GET /2.0/metadata_taxonomies/{namespace}/{taxonomy_key}

name: List metadata taxonomy nodes
description: List metadata taxonomy nodes Used to retrieve metadata taxonomy nodes based on the parameters specified. GET /2.0/metadata_taxonomies/{namespace}/{taxonomy_key}/nodes
context:
GET /2.0/metadata_taxonomies/{namespace}/{taxonomy_key}/nodes
Used to retrieve metadata taxonomy nodes based on the parameters specified. Results are sorted in lexicographic order unless a `query` parameter is passed. With a `query` parameter specified, results are sorted in order of relevance.
Required: namespace (path) — The namespace of the metadata taxonomy.; taxonomy_key (path) — The key of the metadata taxonomy.
Optional: level (query) — Filters results by taxonomy level. Multiple values can be provided. Results include nodes that match any of the specified values.; parent (query) — Node identifier of a direct parent node. Multiple values can be provided. Results include nodes that match any of the specified values.; ancestor (query) — Node identifier of any ancestor node. Multiple values can be provided. Results include nodes that match any of the specified values.; query (query) — Query text to search for the taxonomy nodes.; include-total-result-count (query) — When set to `true` this provides the total number of nodes that matched the query. The response will compute counts of up to 10,000 elements. Defaults to `false`.; marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.
